search_desktop: SearchLab: a retrieval benchmarking lab over 3,203 chunks of five NASA engineering handbooks (Systems Engineering Handbook, Program/Project Management Handbook, NPR 7120.5F, NPR 7123.1D, NPR 7150.2D). Top nav: abstract orbit logo + 'SearchLab', links Search, Vector map, Evaluation, Queries, Sources, a sun/moon theme toggle, and a small pill 'Unofficial · not affiliated with NASA'. Use the SearchLab design system. No NASA logos. SEARCH page. Hero row: title 'Compare retrieval methods' and one-line subtitle. Search card: large input 'Ask the handbooks or type an identifier (e.g. KDP C, SWE-139)', a top-k slider (1-10), a primary Search button, and a row of suggestion chips (clicking a chip only fills the input). Below: three equal columns BM25 (orange dot), Dense (blue dot), Hybrid (teal dot), each with latency in ms, a green banner 'Expected passage at rank 2' when a labeled query is used, and 5 result cards: mono rank chip #1, score bar, section path breadcrumb (e.g. '4.0 System Design > 4.2 Technical Requirements'), document badge 'NPR 7123.1D · p.41', two-line snippet, 'expected' check badge on the correct one. A 'Show on vector map' secondary button above the columns.

eval_desktop: SearchLab: a retrieval benchmarking lab over 3,203 chunks of five NASA engineering handbooks (Systems Engineering Handbook, Program/Project Management Handbook, NPR 7120.5F, NPR 7123.1D, NPR 7150.2D). Top nav: abstract orbit logo + 'SearchLab', links Search, Vector map, Evaluation, Queries, Sources, a sun/moon theme toggle, and a small pill 'Unofficial · not affiliated with NASA'. Use the SearchLab design system. No NASA logos. EVALUATION dashboard. Run picker dropdown with readable labels like 'NASA handbooks · Holdout set · RRF k=60 · 28 Oct 2026'. Run facts strip: N=80 queries, 3,203 chunks, embedding text-embedding-3-small, git SHA, clean tree badge. KPI cards per method: MRR@10 with 95% CI ('0.71 [0.64, 0.78]'), Recall@5, nDCG@10. Charts: (1) Recall@k line chart k=1..10, three method lines with shaded CI bands; (2) MRR@10 by query class (exact identifier, paraphrase, distractor) grouped bars with error whiskers; (3) head-to-head matrix: wins/ties/losses between method pairs as stacked bars; (4) per-query rank heatmap: rows = queries, columns = BM25/Dense/Hybrid, cells colored by rank (1 = deep teal, 10 = pale, miss = red). Caveats box at bottom.
